excluded.reason: Out of the export contract. MoneyMan filters it before writing. A row that arrives anyway is a feed failure, recorded on the Feed status page, and is not mapped.

transactionFields.name: Posted date
transactionFields.notes: Empty while the transaction is pending.

transactionFields.name: Amount
transactionFields.notes: Signed decimal in USD. A charge is negative. A credit or payment is positive.

transactionFields.name: Account
transactionFields.notes: Nickname plus last 4, matching an in-scope display name once the last 4 is known.

transactionFields.name: Last 4
transactionFields.notes: Exactly four digits. This is the only account or card number stored.

transactionFields.name: Institution
transactionFields.notes: Desert Financial, Kemba, Chase, or Citi.

transactionFields.name: Pending
transactionFields.notes: True until the institution posts the transaction.

transactionFields.name: Running balance
transactionFields.notes: Present only when the institution provides a running balance on the transaction.

transactionFields.name: Feed ID
transactionFields.notes: MoneyMan's stable transaction id, hashed. Upsert key. It is not a bank token and not a PAN.

transactionFields.name: Vendor hint
transactionFields.notes: Empty, or AI/cloud/tech for known vendors. Mapping rules are a separate skill story.

balanceFields.name: Date
balanceFields.notes: Calendar day of the snapshot in America/Phoenix. One row per in-scope account per day.

balanceFields.name: Institution
balanceFields.notes: Desert Financial, Kemba, Chase, or Citi.

balanceFields.name: Available
balanceFields.notes: Present when the institution provides an available balance.
